name: daily_sales
title: Daily Sales Report
description: Morning summary of yesterday's sales for management, branch-wise.
rules:
1. Period: yesterday by default; user may give a date or range.
2. Use invoice date, not order date.
3. Exclude cancelled / reversed invoices.
4. Amounts are taxable value EXCLUDING GST, in ₹.
5. Quantity in MT, rounded to 3 decimals.
6. Credit notes of the same period are subtracted.
output_format:
Columns: Branch | Invoices | Qty (MT) | Taxable Amount (₹) | Avg Rate (₹/MT)
Sort by Taxable Amount descending. TOTAL row at the bottom (Invoices, Qty, Amount).
Bar chart: Taxable Amount by Branch.
Summary (3-5 lines, user's language): total sale, top branch, comparison with the same day last week.
sql_template: -- Fill in after teaching: the agent writes and tests this from your schema.
